summary: The Sync - Skia Upstream workflow failed twice while its staged pull-request completion signal targeted a release branch, because that base-branch override was not allowed.

bugSignals.errorMessage: create_pull_request: Base branch override is not allowed. Configure safe-outputs.create-pull-request.allowed-base-branches to allow per-run base overrides.

stepsToReproduce: Run the Sync - Skia Upstream workflow for a release branch.
Allow the agent to invoke the staged create_pull_request completion signal targeting that branch.
Observe safe outputs reject the base-branch override.
reproEvidence.environmentDetails: GitHub Actions workflow runs 37168522926 and 37188747296 on mono/SkiaSharp main.

repoLinks.description: Earlier open report with the identical safe-output error; it is fixed by PR #5259.
Open fix allowing the staged PR output to target the selected base branch or main/release branches.

analysis.summary: This is the same workflow configuration defect reported in #5254: the workflow derives release branch targets but its staged create-pull-request configuration does not permit base overrides, preventing automated sync PR delivery.
analysis.rationale: The two failed runs quote the same deterministic configuration error as #5254. The workflow accepts and propagates a target branch, while its safe-output declaration contains no base-branch allowlist. Open PR #5259 explicitly fixes #5254 by allowing the selected branch or main/release branches, so this report should be tracked as a duplicate.

keySignals.text: create_pull_request: Base branch override is not allowed.
keySignals.interpretation: The failure occurs at safe-output validation, after sync work completed.

keySignals.text: Allow Skia sync safe outputs to target release branches
keySignals.interpretation: An open fix already addresses the same release-branch allowlist defect.

codeInvestigation.finding: The workflow accepts target_branch and passes it into detection, but its staged create-pull-request declaration only sets staged: true and has no allowed base-branch configuration.
The detector validates and assigns a manual base-branch override and also assigns matching release branches as the sync base, establishing the valid non-main targets that the safe output must allow.

actionability.reason: #5254 reports the identical deterministic safe-output failure, and open PR #5259 fixes that report.

actions.description: Apply the build reliability bug classification.
Track this report as a duplicate of #5254.
